sources.title: Ara release-blog
sources.locator: Article title, byline date, Core principles
sources.finding: The first-party10October2026 announcement identifies Reason1.1 as an autonomous software engineer with product-owned session/subagent tools. Vendor benchmark claims are not imported as measurements.

sources.title: Ara guide
sources.locator: Session/Computer definitions; Three paths; Continue a Session
sources.finding: Reason separates cloud inference from commands on a connected user computer or Reason cloud computer; web, CLI and API share Session identity.

sources.title: Ara desktop-app
sources.finding: The desktop worker/app is documented for macOS and Linux and connects the users computer.

sources.title: Ara download-page
sources.finding: The current download page lists available platform builds separately from unavailable targets.

sources.title: Ara add-models
sources.locator: Three connection ways; Settings Models; API credential operations
sources.finding: Provider subscription sign-ins, user API keys and custom model endpoints feed Reason Sessions. These model routes are not separate integrated coding CLIs.

sources.title: Ara build/computers
sources.locator: Local or cloud; Which computer the agent picks; What your computer exposes
sources.finding: Commands can execute locally or in managed cloud, and the agent has explicit placement rules for heavy/parallel/sleep-proof work. Local folder grants remain user permissions.

sources.title: Ara reasons
sources.finding: A Reason is a persistent product-owned agent that can start Sessions and Loops with its own defaults and instructions.

sources.title: Ara sessions-reference
sources.finding: The Session API explicitly defines native subagent nesting, shared100-live-agent tree cap and opt-in subagent Session creation, with inherited policies.

sources.title: Ara loops
sources.locator: What wakes a Loop; Schedules; settings; limits
sources.finding: Product Loops support timed, webhook, GitHub and Slack wakes that start/continue Sessions, with model/plan limits and pause causes.

sources.title: Ara github
sources.finding: The product GitHub integration creates Session branches/PRs, follows checks/reviews, exposes a review pane and can merge subject to GitHub rules and optional draft-only policy.

sources.title: Ara plans
sources.finding: New plans require paid Pro/Max access, eligible Pro customers have a3-day card-required trial and grandfathered Free with ads is no longer offered. User-connected models bill separately.

sources.title: Ara privacy
sources.locator: Usage/device/diagnostics; Analytics and Session Replay; Installation and Update Telemetry
sources.finding: The policy discloses identified PostHog analytics/session replay plus Axiom/Sentry and install/update telemetry. A privacy request is not described as an in-app kill switch.

sources.title: Ara terms
sources.finding: The main Service/software is owned by Reason and supplied under a limited revocable license with redistribution restrictions.

sources.title: Ara changelog
sources.finding: Current notes separate weekly Reason Agent, desktop and CLI version ranges. The newest visible week is16November2026.

sources.title: Ara security
sources.locator: How are cloud computers isolated; What can Reason do on my own computer
sources.finding: The security guide says each cloud computer is a separate VM in one Workspace with outbound allowlist; local commands use granted folders and user permissions.
